### 2026-10-07 – # SO!! I MADE A VERY CUTE-SY Schematic today!!

**3h**

# SO!! I MADE A VERY CUTE-SY Schematic today!!

Well it is cute and functional!

This will be my new and improved macropad, my forth design from scratch!

Features Of This Hackpad:-

+ 9 keys(not too many not too less)
+ 0.91" OLED
+ Backlighting with sk6812 mini-e
+ XIAO RP2060 based

### 2026-10-08 – Did layout and completed routing!

**4h**

Did layout and completed routing!

So I finally did the routing of the macropad it was pretty easy, for the ground pour i just had to pop a few grounding via to connect disconnected parts of the ground plane and it was done!

It was easy enough though i had to design my own iteration of the sk6812 mini-e footprint to fit the LCSC documentation.  Next up is DRC and some silkscreen art!!
